reuse.why: The change reuses budget setters, batching, sheet helpers and average calculations, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses the new shared category selector.

duplication.why: Most month-wide selection and average logic is consolidated, but copyPreviousMonth retains a second implementation of the category eligibility policy.

placement.why: Budget selection and mutation logic remains in the existing budget server modules, with method registration following the established app layer.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on month-wide budget actions, their shared exclusions, registration, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared selector and average dispatcher simplify maintenance, but future eligibility changes still require coordinating the selector with copyPreviousMonth.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth independently applies eligibility rules instead of using getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts expresses hidden, income, template and fixed-group eligibility through SQL and filtering in getMonthWideCategories, then repeats that policy as imperative guards over budget rows in copyPreviousMonth.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and its conditional hidden-filter branch, while copyPreviousMonth independently implements the same policy and flag.
